summary: The diff implements the majority of requirements (REQ-127 through REQ-135). Backend discount code and payment settings storage are added, frontend hooks are created, Dashboard has a Payment Settings tab, Checkout has promo code support, PaymentSuccess shows bonus items and app URL, ProductDetailView has shipping/returns notices, Terms and Privacy Policy pages are updated. One notable gap is that the discount passed to the Stripe checkout session creation is described as applied proportionally to line items in the file summary. Backend stable storage for discount codes and payment settings is mentioned but the truncated diff limits full verification.
